description: Proposed use of Northern part of site for car sales (Use Class: Sui Generis) for a period of twelve months
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the land restored to its former condition on or before 12 months after the date of this decision.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for Car Sales purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times Monday to Saturday 9am to 6pm.

Condition : 4 - The hereby approved use shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the F&D Motor Sales Operating Statement received:27th February 2019 for the duration of the use. No deliveries or collections shall be carried out by a transporter.
Condition : 5 - The existing fence shall be retained on site and maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site.

Condition : 6 - Only vehicles associated with the hereby approved use shall be granted access via Wellington Road North. No other vehicles associated with any other use shall be granted access to any other part of the site known as 152 Bath Road, Hounslow for the duration of the use.

Condition : 7 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 8 - All vehicle movements to and from site shall take place using the site access on Wellington Road North only and no vehicle shall enter or exit the site directly from/onto Bath Road.
Condition : 9 - The land subject to this application shall not be used other than for the purpose of vehicle sales
